{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where baseline is -999.0 (invalid)
valid_data = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the change from baseline to follow-up
delta = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change
average_change = delta.mean()

print(f"Valid participant count: {len(valid_data)}")
print(f"Average change in biomarker (ng/mL): {average_change}")"}
